stepTitle: Define Keyboard And Mouse Injection Oracle
description: Pins the Win64 injection protocol used to drive a running DOOM.EXE process for deterministic oracle capture. Each event from the 02-009 deterministic input stream is translated into Windows SendInput INPUT records targeting the foreground DOOM window. Keyboard events use INPUT_KEYBOARD with KEYEVENTF_SCANCODE so the host's IME layer is bypassed. Mouse-move events use relative motion with MOUSEEVENTF_MOVE. Mouse-button events use MOUSEEVENTF_LEFTDOWN/UP, MOUSEEVENTF_RIGHTDOWN/UP, and MOUSEEVENTF_MIDDLEDOWN/UP. Injection is synchronized with the DOOM tic clock by gating each batch on the 02-004 manifest's 35 Hz tic rate so events fire at deterministic tic boundaries.
